summary: @or-sdk/billing preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a package-local file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle whose body is a scrambled string/integer array plus a decoder function (`hc1jfK9`) that reconstructs strings from a shuffled alphabet. Because the bundle is executed under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node, its behavior does not appear in Node-based inspection of the tarball and runs automatically on `npm install`. A billing SDK has no legitimate need to acquire a second language runtime at install time and execute an obfuscated sibling script under it; the combination — alternate-runtime fetch, opaque payload smuggled past Node scanners, no hash/signature verification, unconditional preinstall execution — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
